metadata.title: Fact-Check Generation
metadata.note: CLI reel of how the Chapter 14 fact-check report is generated. Greeting Hello Novia. Voice af_bella. Cap 3:30. Does not re-teach TME biology.

beats.role_note: COLD OPEN LAW — ask shown answered; Hello Novia
beats.narration_text: Hello Novia. A fact-check report is a workbook, not a vibe. You take every sentence in the chapter, classify it, and write the decision down. Chapter fourteen: one hundred thirty-eight sentences, three sheets. Here is how that report gets built.

props.command: claude "build the Chapter 14 fact-check workbook: count every sentence, split AI-only vs web-flagged, then the editorial sheet"

beats.role_note: FRAMEWORK — four moves that generate the report
beats.narration_text: Four moves. Count every sentence. Send statistics, guidelines, approvals, evidence, specialist claims, and dated facts to the web — those are web-flagged. Mark the rest AI-only, each with a reason it was not googled. Then an editorial sheet for the chapter against itself, and a reread of the AI-only pile for inverted mechanisms. Skip a step, and it is not a review.
beats.visual_intent: Layer stack: split / AI-only reasons / editorial + reread

layers.title: 1 — Count, then split
layers.sub: Every sentence: web-flagged (STAT, guideline, approval, evidence, specialist, current) or AI-only

layers.title: 2 — Sheet B keeps the reason
layers.sub: AI-only is classified, not googled — that decision is the record

layers.title: 3 — Editorial, then reread
layers.sub: Sheet C: chapter vs itself. Then reread Sheet B for inverted mechanisms

props.caption: The report is those four moves written into a workbook.

beats.narration_text: First reconstruction. Into Claude: write the ledger from the Chapter 14 counts. One hundred thirty-eight total. Forty-six go to the web. Split the ninety-two AI-only by the six chapter files, in reading order.

props.command:
claude "write ch14_ledger.py from the Chapter 14 fact-check:
  TOTAL=138
  FLAGGED=46  (web: STAT/GUIDELINE/APPROVAL/EVIDENCE/SPECIALIST/CURRENT)
  AI-ONLY by file: Intro 8, Components 33, Stroma 13,
    Inflammation 17, ECM 16, Summary 5
  print the first-pass ledger"

beats.narration_text: The constants are the chapter: one hundred thirty-eight, forty-six flagged, ninety-two AI-only. The by-file dict is the AI-only pile. Assert they sum, so a file cannot vanish. First pass only prints the forty-six. That is a partial report — steps one and two, with sheet B missing.

props.title: ch14_ledger.py
props.sparkLine: A split with no AI-only sheet is incomplete.

beats.role_note: Manim: 92 vs 46, then AI-only bars by file
beats.narration_text: The split, on screen. Ninety-two AI-only on the left. Forty-six sent to the web on the right. Bars are the ninety-two by file — Components is the fat one, thirty-three sentences. A report that only publishes the forty-six has dropped the classifier's no.
beats.visual_intent: Two big numbers 92 / 46; six terracotta bars of AI-only by file

beats.narration_text: The report is generated in four moves: count, split, editorial, reread. Three sheets. Not a green check on the textbook. Hide sheet B and you cannot audit the classifier. Skip sheet C and the chapter's own contradictions ship.

shot.show: verdict artifact of the four-move protocol

props.artifactTitle: How the Chapter 14 report is generated
artifactLines: 2. Split: 46 web-flagged, 92 AI-only with a reason.
3. Editorial sheet: 8 findings — the chapter vs itself.
4. Reread the 92: 5 flags, including reversed IL-23.

beats.role_note: HANDOFF LAW — rubric on the next chapter
beats.narration_text: Your turn. Paste this on another chapter. Build the three sheets before you argue with any one sentence. Score it: every sentence counted? AI-only sheet with a reason per row? At least one same-file contradiction on the editorial sheet? If any of those is missing, it is not a finished report.

props.command:
claude "Generate the fact-check report for the next chapter.
(1) Count every sentence. Split AI-ONLY vs web-flagged (STAT/GUIDELINE/APPROVAL/EVIDENCE/SPECIALIST/CURRENT).
(2) AI-ONLY sheet: file, sentence, why it was not googled.
(3) Editorial sheet: same-file contradictions, grammar, failed drugs written as current.
(4) Reread AI-ONLY for inverted mechanisms.
Score: every sentence counted? reasons on sheet B? at least one same-file contradiction?"
